source.note: The card is READ-ONLY to this repository. Nothing here writes on a `>` line (R-2026-09-05-03). `--against-card` re-reads the card and compares the transcription below to it.

acceptance.tom_verbatim: Q3–Q5, Q12 and Q13 are accepted at the sheet's defaults
acceptance.durable_store_status: the sentence is in a transcript, not in RULINGS.md; every line below therefore stays `default, unruled` and DEFERRED.md carries the [OPERATOR] row

lines.question: CONSOLIDATED Q3: routing preference order
lines.default_proposed: Adopt the ReleasePolicy default preference order and let a loaded batch supply the values; do not set it explicitly now.

bindings.why: "Adopt the default" is exactly `defaultReleasePolicy.routingPreference`; a loaded batch supplies its own by passing a ReleasePolicy, which is data.

lines.question: CONSOLIDATED Q4: congestion policy
lines.default_proposed: Wait when the preferred member is congested, with escalation on capability floor, deadline, or a failed verdict only — a closed list of three triggers.

bindings.why: "Wait when the preferred member is congested" is the `Wait` tag; `EscalateAfter` is the other reading and is not the default.

The second half of the line — "escalation on capability floor, deadline, or a failed verdict only" — is a closed list of three, and the union is where the closure lives. A fourth member added to the union widens the sheet's answer without a ruling.

lines.question: CONSOLIDATED Q5: the length exponent
lines.default_proposed: 1.0 until measurement, so the attended/unattended flip is a sign change and nothing more.

bindings.why: The field carries the exponent; the default reaches it through the named constant below, so the two must agree.

bindings.name: DEFAULT_LENGTH_EXPONENT
bindings.why: `defaultReleasePolicy.lengthExponent` is not a literal; it is this constant. A repin of the constant is a repin of the sheet's answer and is caught here.
